baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two rooted terms in مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ converge on need, but the second gives the first a bodily location.
baseline_models.mechanism: The س ك ن branch supplies poverty, weakness, and abasement, while the ت ر ب branch turns need into clinging contact with dust. The phrase therefore intensifies rather than merely repeats: a social condition acquires posture and material texture.

activation_trace.role: Poverty and humble abasement supply the person's condition of need and lowered social power.
Poverty figured as clinging to dust materializes abasement as ground-contact.

changed_reading.before: A poor person in severe poverty.
changed_reading.after: A person whose need has lowered and ground-bound them, so poverty is encountered as an embodied relation to dust.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِسْكِينًا retains latent س ك ن images of dwelling and rest beside مَتْرَبَةٍ as bare earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dwelling and familiar rest remain audible behind the noun, but the only place supplied by its modifier is soil. The construction can thus stage failed architecture: habitation has collapsed to the ground itself.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling and settlement supply the absent norm against which the person's location is read.
An object or place of rest makes lodging and comfort the function that bare earth has failed to provide.
Soil, earth, and dust supply the exposed surface that has become the person's only resting place.

changed_reading.before: A destitute person associated with dust.
changed_reading.after: An unhoused person for whom bare earth has become lodging and bed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cessation image in س ك ن and the clinging image in ت ر ب meet inside the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Need appears as a loss of practical motion: one root removes movement and the other adheres the person to the ground. The noun is therefore not only a rank on an economic scale but a condition of constrained exit.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after movement supplies the arrest or inability to continue.
Clinging to dust gives that arrested condition a downward, adhesive force.

changed_reading.before: A static label for an impoverished person.
changed_reading.after: A person whose poverty has stopped movement and narrowed the possibility of leaving the condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ذَا construction marks possession while ت ر ب contains opposed branches of dust-bound poverty and dust-like abundance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can carry a bitter internal reversal: the person is grammatically a possessor, yet what is possessed is dust. The same root's wealth branch remains as the excluded opposite, making the dust feel like a grotesque abundance.

activation_trace.role: Dust-clinging poverty supplies the actual possession named by the construction.
Wealth imagined as dust-like abundance supplies an excluded opposite and makes the possession of dust ironic.

changed_reading.after: An ironic possessor whose only abundance is dust, with wealth present as the root's unavailable shadow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated bounded city and the images of residence and occupying a place enlarge the failed-dwelling baseline. The focus person is inside a civic enclosure but has not received its basic spatial promise; settlement has contracted to exposed soil.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling and settlement make habitable placement the focus person's missing condition.
Bare earth supplies the residual location left when dwelling fails.
A bounded tract of land supplies the civic enclosure within which the exposed person is located.
Residence and attachment to a town sharpen the contrast between belonging to a city and lacking a dwelling.
Occupying or alighting in a place makes emplacement, not abstract scenery, part of the spatial mechanism.

structural_cues: الْبَلَدِ is repeated in 90:1-2 before the focus person's earth-level location is disclosed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded city, residence, emplacement, dwelling, and bare earth; I supply the contrast that a city containing an earth-lodged person has failed as habitation. A live alternative is that the city remains only an oath setting and حِلّ carries a legal rather than locative force.

changed_reading.before: One unhoused individual rests on bare earth.
changed_reading.after: A bounded city's inhabitant has been denied effective habitation, turning private destitution into a civic spatial failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation, a spoken claim, exhausted expenditure, wealth, piled mass, and sight surround the focus root's own poverty/wealth polarity. The dust-bound person becomes a counter-ledger: verbal claims of consuming heaps are tested by whether abundance crossed the gap to the person whose only heap is dust.

activation_trace.role: Poverty as clinging to dust supplies the embodied deficit against which expenditure is measured.
Dust-like abundance supplies the latent wealth pole that makes the focus phrase an inverted possession.
Counting and accounting supply the ledger frame within which the wealth claim is assessed.
Uttered speech marks the expenditure first as a claimant's statement rather than as demonstrated transfer.
Exhausting and consuming effort gives the claim its image of resources used up.
Acquired and abundant wealth supplies the stock whose movement or nonmovement is at issue.
A mass piled layer upon layer supplies the claimant's abundance and mirrors the focus person's grotesque abundance of dust.
Seeing by eye or insight makes actual social consequence, rather than narration alone, the evidence.

structural_cues: 90:5 and 90:7 repeat يَحْسَبُ around the 90:6 wealth claim.
The later feeding sequence supplies a concrete destination for expenditure before 90:16 names its recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, claimed expenditure, piled wealth, seeing, and the focus root's opposed poverty and abundance branches; I infer that the recipient's condition audits whether wealth truly moved. The live alternative is that the abundance branch belongs to a form too distant from مَتْرَبَةٍ to affect this phrase.

changed_reading.before: The focus person is the passive endpoint of possible charity.
changed_reading.after: The dust-bound person is the material counter-ledger that exposes the difference between boasting of spent heaps and actually converting wealth into another person's survival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing, the eye, a visible sign, and covering form an epistemic sequence around an outwardly dusty body. The focus person can be carried as a socially visible sign: failure to respond is not lack of data but an active covering of what has been made perceptible.

activation_trace.role: Visible weakness and abasement supply the human condition that calls for recognition.
Dust supplies an outward material mark rather than an invisible account balance.
Sight and insight establish the possibility of witnessing conduct and condition.
The seeing eye supplies the embodied capacity by which the focus person's condition can be recognized.
Covering supplies the counteraction that can hide or refuse an already visible condition.
A manifest sign supplies the revelatory function abductively assigned to the dusty human body.

structural_cues: The question of being seen in 90:7 is followed by the gift of two eyes in 90:8, while 90:19 juxtaposes covering with signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, eyes, a manifest sign, covering, and a materially marked focus person; I supply the arrow that the poor person's body itself functions as a sign. A live alternative is that the signs in 90:19 refer only to revelation and do not point back to the recipient.

changed_reading.before: A needy person waits to be noticed.
changed_reading.after: The person's dust-marked condition is already visible evidence; overlooking it becomes an act of covering rather than innocent unawareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, elevation, hazardous entry, and a steep obstacle convert the arrested-motion baseline into topography. Because the obstacle is subsequently specified through release and feeding, ascent is not private heroism: it is enacted by restoring motion and possibility to someone stuck at ground level.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of movement supplies the focus person's stalled position on the moral terrain.
Clinging to dust locates that stalled position at the terrain's lowest surface.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies orientation before the difficult crossing.
Elevation supplies the high ground toward which the path rises.
Entering lethal or difficult stretches of road supplies the force required to cross.
The steep, projecting obstacle supplies the terrain whose human meaning the feeding sequence discloses.

structural_cues: 90:10 presents two elevated ways, 90:11-12 repeats the obstacle, and 90:13-16 answers its meaning with release and feeding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, height, dangerous passage, steepness, cessation, and ground-clinging; I supply the arrow that crossing the obstacle means transferring mobility to the stalled person. The live alternative is a purely inward moral-ascent metaphor with the recipient only as one listed deed.

changed_reading.before: Aid reaches a person immobilized by poverty.
changed_reading.after: The dirt-bound person's restored possibility of movement is what makes the agent's own crossing of the height real.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening a bond and releasing a neck are coordinated with feeding amid exhausting hunger. The shared functional mechanism is de-binding: legal captivity and metabolic captivity differ in material, but both close down agency. The focus person's stillness and adhesion to dust make feeding an act of release.

activation_trace.role: Stopped movement supplies the loss of agency that feeding must reverse.
Adhesion to dust supplies the material image of being held down.
Release from pledge, bondage, or closure supplies the explicit de-binding operation.
The neck supplies the embodied captive whose release is coordinated with feeding.
Giving food to another supplies the intervention that loosens metabolic constraint.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies the bodily force that has bound and stilled the recipient.

structural_cues: 90:13 and 90:14 are coordinated answers to the same obstacle, and 90:15-16 complete the feeding construction with its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal release, a neck, feeding, exhausting hunger, stillness, and ground-clinging; I supply the shared arrow that feeding releases a different kind of captivity. A live alternative is that release and feeding are merely separate virtues in a list.

changed_reading.before: The person is an object of charitable feeding.
changed_reading.after: The person is captive to a material condition, and feeding is a liberation that restores agency rather than a discretionary gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rainless land, a severe event-time, famine-hunger, and the act of feeding can be assembled into an ecological supply chain. Soil becomes dust, hunger removes the provision that enables staying, and the person is immobilized at the endpoint of land and food-system failure.

activation_trace.role: Provision that enables remaining in place supplies the missing stabilizer in the focus person's condition.
Earth and dust supply the environmental substrate at the end of the proposed drying process.
Land without rain supplies the possible ecological initiating condition.
Feeding another supplies the repair at the human end of the failed supply chain.
A day's severe event supplies crisis timing rather than a timeless personal identity.
Famine-hunger with exhaustion supplies the metabolic consequence of scarcity.

structural_cues: The focus person remains grammatically governed by feeding in the explicitly time-bounded day of hunger begun in 90:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rainless land, earth, crisis-time, famine, missing provision, and feeding; I supply the causal arrows rain failure to food scarcity to immobilized destitution. A live alternative is that the hunger is economic or political rather than ecological, and the rainless-land branch of أَهْلَكْ is form-distant.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a stable social class called poor.
changed_reading.after: The focus may name a person temporarily produced by ecological and provisioning collapse, making timely feeding a repair of a system as well as a body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local twin construction sets a child severed from a caregiver but possessing kin-nearness beside a poor person possessing dust. Household, peer, kinship, and womb-relations activate a social reading: for the focus person, earth occupies the relational slot where a support network might have stood.

activation_trace.role: Household inhabitants supply the support unit latent in the focus noun and potentially absent from the person's life.
Peers and equal companions supply a form-distant relational alternative to the literal dust now accompanying the person.
Severance of a child from a caregiver supplies an explicit model of broken support.
Kinship and lineage supply the nearby human relation occupying the parallel modifier in the preceding ayah.
Womb-kinship extends the support-network image beyond the immediate grammatical pair.

structural_cues: 90:15 and 90:16 form the close parallel يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ / مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed care, kin-nearness, household, peerhood, and the parallel ذَا constructions; I infer that dust fills a relational slot left vacant by failed support. A live alternative is that the parallel simply names two independent priority recipients and says nothing about the poor person's kin.

changed_reading.after: The person may also be one whose household and peer network has failed, leaving earth itself as the nearest companion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal counsel, sustained responsibility, mercy, and companionship follow the feeding act. Together with the focus roots' household and peer images, they shift the endpoint from one-way relief to incorporation: the recipient can be encountered as an equal participant in a durable mutual community.

activation_trace.role: Household membership supplies a durable relation beyond a single transfer of food.
Equal-age companionship supplies the latent peer status that resists objectifying the recipient.
Mutual recommendation among a group supplies reciprocal rather than unilateral social action.
Bearing an ongoing responsibility supplies duration and commitment after emergency feeding.
Tender mercy supplies the affective bond joining material aid to community.
Companionship and continued association supply the collective form into which the encounter can grow.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ follows the feeding recipients, تَوَاصَوْا is repeated reciprocally, and the next ayah names companions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household, peerhood, reciprocal counsel, sustained obligation, mercy, and companionship; I infer that the recipient can be incorporated into the mutual group rather than remaining its object. A live alternative is that 90:17-18 characterize only the aid-givers.

changed_reading.before: A donor gives food downward to a passive recipient.
changed_reading.after: The encounter can initiate peerhood and shared endurance, making the dust-bound person a companion rather than a completed charity case.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus person's lack of shelter and the final image of fire closed over its occupants create opposite failures of enclosure. One body has no protective boundary and rests on open earth; other bodies have boundary without exit. A merciful dwelling emerges as the livable middle between exposure and incarceration.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling supplies the protective enclosure absent from the focus person's condition.
Familiar rest supplies the humane function that distinguishes shelter from mere confinement.
Open earth supplies the exposed pole of the spatial contrast.
Kindled fire supplies the harmful interior contained by the final enclosure.
Closing something over its contents supplies enclosure without escape on the dominant mapped root.
Bolting a door securely supplies the same no-exit closure through the non-dominant mapped root.

structural_cues: The exposed focus body in 90:16 and the closed-over bodies in 90:20 occupy opposite ends of the short concluding sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dwelling, rest, open earth, fire, and two mapped images of tight closure; I supply the spatial polarity and the humane middle of shelter-with-rest. A live alternative is that the final enclosure is independent eschatological imagery with no backward relation to housing.

changed_reading.before: The focus person simply lacks shelter.
changed_reading.after: The person marks one pole of an enclosure spectrum: mercy must create a dwelling that protects without becoming the locked, harmful enclosure at the other pole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare knife-stilling branch behind مِسْكِينًا and brings it beside a neck, release, and famine-hunger. It remains anchored in the focus root and in the coordinated release/feeding sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for starvation's lethal arrest, never as the lexical meaning of مِسْكِين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The س ك ن branch in مِسْكِينًا can image a blade ending movement, while مَتْرَبَةٍ supplies earth at the edge of bodily extinction.

activation_trace.role: A knife stilling a slaughtered body supplies the extreme image of hunger bringing motion toward an end.
Earth and dust supply the body's low material horizon in the analogy.
Release from closure or bondage supplies the reversal of lethal arrest.
The neck supplies an explicitly vulnerable body beside the focus body's threatened stilling.
Giving food supplies the life-preserving interruption of the stilling process.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies the bodily mechanism capable of driving movement toward cessation.

changed_reading.before: The person suffers extreme but static poverty.
changed_reading.after: The person can be seen as a life already being stilled by hunger, so feeding interrupts an incipient death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain chain is surprising because it joins the rare rudder branch in س ك ن to guidance, a split-root steep descent, a form-distant boat image, and reciprocal counsel. It remains branch-backed and anchored in مِسْكِينًا as an analogy for ethical orientation, but it must never be rendered as a translation of مِسْكِين or مَقْرَبَة; the person is a diagnostic rudder only metaphorically.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The س ك ن inventory allows the focus noun to activate the device that steadies and corrects a vessel, while the person's dust-clinging fixes the point toward which correction is measured.

activation_trace.role: A rudder steadying and correcting a ship supplies the focus person's metaphorical orienting function.
Clinging to dust fixes the concrete human point by which the community's course is tested.
Direction, manner, and intended course supply the navigational decision that needs correction.
The non-dominant mapped root's steep descent supplies hazardous terrain that makes steering consequential.
A small boat supplies the form-distant vessel image that lets the rudder branch become a coherent material analogy.
Reciprocal counsel supplies the collective steering practice rather than a solitary donor's impulse.

changed_reading.before: The poor person is a passenger or burden carried by the community.
changed_reading.after: The grounded person's condition functions as the community's rudder: its course is disclosed by whether collective guidance steers resources toward that person.

strongest_changes: Poverty became embodied arrest, failed dwelling, and contact with the ground rather than an abstract economic label.
The opposed poverty and abundance branches of ت ر ب turned the focus person into a counter-ledger for the claim of spending piled wealth.
The height-obstacle-release-feeding sequence made aid a transfer of mobility and a form of material liberation.
The 90:15-18 relational sequence allowed earth to mark a failed support network while also activating the recipient as a possible peer and companion.
Ecological crisis and the final enclosure opened additional coexisting system-level readings without displacing the civic, bodily, and social ones.
summary.what_was_special: Both focus roots are internally reversible: س ك ن moves among abasement, stillness, dwelling, provision, household, and steering, while ت ر ب moves among dust, poverty, abundance, and peerhood. Context did not disambiguate those branches; it activated distinct civic, accounting, topographic, liberatory, ecological, relational, visual, and enclosure mechanisms that can coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The wealth and peer branches of ت ر ب are illuminating but form-distant from مَتْرَبَةٍ.
The rainless-land to famine to dust causal chain is reader-supplied and may yield to economic or political scarcity.
The visible-sign and exposure/overclosure models depend on cross-ayah juxtaposition rather than explicit syntax.
The knife-stilling and rudder readings are deliberately contained material analogies, not lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The poor person as settled into dust.** Lexical evidence: س ك ن B006 “poverty and humble abasement,” B001 “cessation/settling,” ت ر ب B001 “soil, earth, dust,” B002 “poverty as clinging to dust.” Structural cue: this is the second recipient after the near orphan and completes the feeding specification. Assigned role: مسكين supplies immobilized need; متربة supplies earth-contact. Abductive move: I infer an image of someone whose poverty has brought them down to ground-level. Reading change: the ayah reads as bodily abasement in dust, not merely low income.

2. **The city’s dust returns as the ground of obligation.** Lexical evidence: ب ل د B001 included dust/open land; ب ل د B010 “sticking or pressing to the ground”; ت ر ب B001/B002 dust-poverty. Structural cue: the oath by the city returns in the dust-covered poor person. Assigned role: متربة localizes poverty in the very earth of the sworn balad. Abductive move: I infer that the city is judged by the bodies pressed into its dust. Reading change: the “balad” is no longer just the oath’s setting; it contains visible dust-poverty that defines the pass.

3. **Dust-wealth reversal.** Lexical evidence: ت ر ب B003 “wealth as dust-like abundance,” against م و ل B001 and ل ب د B002 in 90:6. Structural cue: the speaker’s piled wealth stands before the dust-poor recipient. Assigned role: ت ر ب’s wealth branch creates an ironic overlap: dust can mark abundance or destitution. Abductive move: I infer the reversal that his dust-like abundance should answer another’s dust-like abasement. Reading change: the ayah exposes wealth and poverty as two dust-states, one hoarded and one suffered.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 90:1’s بلد branches became newly active here: the sworn place ends in a person stuck to its dust. 90:18–19 then sorted people by whether they responded to that dust.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inhabited Land and Stable Dwelling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: People descend into a bounded place, inhabit it, and become its settled residents.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bounded land or town `ب ل د:B001/m01`; alighting and settling `ح ل ل:B002/m01`; inhabiting a home `س ك ن:B002/m01`; dwelling site or layer `س ك ن:B009/m01`; place and established position `ك و ن:B002/m01`; remaining in the town `ب ل د:B009/m01`; resident inhabitant `ن ج د:B012/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Settlement is a sequence of arrival, location, residence, and persistence. A bounded site becomes a social place when descent into it is followed by inhabitation and continued presence across its dwellings or layers.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kişinin içinin yöneldiği ve yanında dinginleştiği sevgiliyi ya da şeyi temel alır; gece, yakarış ve ateş bunun örnekleridir. Dal çerçevesi bu rahatlatıcı ve yakınlık veren dayanağı doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Odak iç dinginliği sağlayan kişi veya şeydir; yalnız fiziksel durma, ağırbaşlı iç durum ya da salt sıcaklık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın olarak kişinin yanında rahatlayıp dinginleştiği dayanağı verir; gece, yakarış ve ateş kullanımları ile ateşle düzeltme ayrı bağlamlara bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin yakınlık duyup yanında rahatladığı, içinin yatıştığı kişi veya şeydir. Gece, destekleyici yakarış ve yanında oturulan ateş bu rahatlatıcı işlevle adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Kişi sevdiği veya yakın bulduğu birine ya da şeye yönelir ve onun yanında içi yatışır.
Gece ve destekleyici yakarış, dinlenme veya güven verme işlevleriyle aynı adlandırma alanına girer.
Yanında oturulup yakınlık ve rahatlık bulunan ateş bu anlamın somut bir gerçekleşmesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ağırbaşlılık, yumuşak başlılık, güven ve kalbin yatışmasını aynı iç durum çevresinde birleştirir. Sandık içindeki şeyin insanlara güven verip kaçmalarını önlemesi bu çekirdeğin özel anlatısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dış hareketin yalnızca durmasını değil, güvenle birleşen ağırbaşlı ve dingin iç durumu anlatır; yoksulluk ve ezilmişlik ayrı kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ağırbaşlı iç dinginliği yalın çekirdek yapar; kalbe verilmesi ve sandıktaki güven verici şey yalnız kendi kalıpları içinde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Korku ve taşkınlığın yerini güvenin, ağırbaşlılığın ve yumuşak bir iç dinginliğinin almasıdır. Kalbe verilen güven ile topluluğu bir arada tutan sandık içeriği bu durumun özel anlatımlarıdır.

facets.statement: İç dünyada güven, dinginlik ve ağırbaşlılık birlikte belirir.
Kalbin korkudan kurtulup güven duyması bu iç durumun belirgin gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir sandığın içindeki güven verici şey, insanların kalplerini yatıştırıp onları bir arada tutması bakımından adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağırbaşlılık, yumuşak başlılık, güven ve kalp dinginliğini ortak bir iç durum olarak sunar; kalbe güven verilmesi ve sandıktaki güven verici şey bunun özel anlatılarıdır.

facets.statement: Parmak uçları dalın temel ve sınırlı anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir bitki adı temel anlamdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, adı geçen biçimin bir bitki veya bitki türü olduğunu bildirir; daha ayrıntılı tür tanımı ortak kanıtta yer almaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Adın bitki türü olarak kullanıldığı durumlarda uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bitki adlandırma alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir bitki adıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi birden çok yer adını ve bunların bazı coğrafi açıklamalarını verir. İlk yanıt yüzey biçimi üretmemeli; bu yüzden dal belirli yer adları olarak açıklanır, adların Türkçe biçimleri ise üretilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal adlandırılmış yerlerle sınırlıdır; toprak, gömü yeri, bitki ve durum anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım belirli ad biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; çıplak kök anlamı veya genel yer kavramı olarak genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yerlerin veya vadilerin adı olarak kullanılan biçimler bu dalın çekirdeğidir; dal genel toprak ya da yer kavramı değildir.

facets.statement: Belirli yer adları dalın temel anlamıdır.
Kanıt bazı adlar için yakınlık veya vadi olma gibi coğrafi açıklama verir.
Adlar birden çok yer biçimini kapsar; bunlar ortak bir genel isim anlamına indirgenmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, birkaç biçimin belirli yer veya vadi adı olarak kullanıldığını gösterir; ortak anlam genel yer değil, adlandırılmış coğrafi varlıklardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deve türünden hayvan için uysal ve kolay yönetilir olma niteliğini verir. Dal genel itaat veya bütün binek hayvanları değil, özellikle deveye uygulanan uysallık sıfatıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal çıplak sıfat biçimiyle deve için uysallığı anlatır; özel bir kalıp şartı yoktur.

facets.statement: Devenin uysal ve kolay yönetilir olması temel anlamdır.
